## **Sinclair Names David Adams Vice President and General Manager of WHP in Harrisburg**


11.17.2026


**HARRISBURG, Pa. – November 17, 2026** – Sinclair today announced that David Adams has been named Vice President and General Manager of WHP/CBS,


GHP/CW and EHP/MY


in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania.


Adams brings more than 20 years of executive leadership experience across broadcast television, digital media, advertising, and technology. He joins Sinclair from PowerNation Studios at Gray Media, where he served as Vice President of Sales and Operations.


“David brings an impressive combination of leadership experience, business acumen and deep expertise in both traditional and digital media,” said Rob Weisbord, Chief Operating Officer and President of Local Media at Sinclair. “His ability to build strong teams, develop strategic partnerships and identify new revenue opportunities makes him an excellent fit for our Harrisburg operations. We're excited to welcome him to Sinclair and look forward to the impact he'll have on our business and the communities we serve.”


“It is an honor to lead the WHP CBS 21 station in Harrisburg. I look forward to being a part of the award-winning news / content teams that daily serve the surrounding community, as well as the talented employees that offer world-class advertising and marketing solutions to our partners. I am excited to join a group of people that deliver such exceptional experiences for the Central PA region and The Capital of the Commonwealth,” said Adams.


Previously, Adams held senior leadership positions at iPromote, where he served as VP of Sales and Revenue; Lee Enterprises/Amplified Media, where he was Market President and VP of Sales; and Gannett/GateHouse Media, where he served as President and VP of Sales. Earlier in his career, he held sales leadership roles at Raycom Media, AT&T Advertising and Valpak/Cox Target Media.


Adams holds an MBA from the University of West Florida.


**About Sinclair**


Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. Sinclair owns, operates and/or provides services to 181 television stations in 79 markets and is the owner of Tennis Channel and several national multicast networks. Sinclair's content is delivered via multiple platforms, including over-the-air, multichannel video program distributors and digital platforms. For more information, visit


[www.sbgi.net](http://www.sbgi.net/) .
